evidence: PASS for the workbook's plausibility bar, not a measured Oracle score. All 3 gate, 23 functional, 2 polish and 3 visual criteria have plausible golden implementations. Paths below use .qc-cache/coldwater-editor-2026-10-02-r3/task/solution/app/ as prefix. (1) The custom DIV surface and real key/mouse handlers are src/custom-editor.js:18,34-50,224-322,325-420; they support line joins and caret movement, grapheme boundaries, double/triple/drag selection and actual clipboard copying (464-502,524-552,625-669,773-904). Block indentation excludes an end at column zero and stores one undo snapshot; multicaret insertion groups sequential keys and deletion is atomic (569-623,672-714,827-860). Case-sensitive search, current replacement and all replacement use actual source and undo state (960-1059); new edits clear redo (191-204). Golden logs report grapheme/blockIndent, exact copied word/line/range, 3-caret MULTI insertion with one undo/redo, atomic backward/forward deletion, and navigation/find-wrap. (2) JS tokenization plus AST function declaration/call coloring and HTML tag/attribute/value/comment tokenization are src/custom-editor.js:99-170; CSS gives distinct visible treatments. Prettier formatting uses parser-specific plugins and two-space indentation, preserves the pre-format snapshot and reports errors (75-96). Matrix script assertions compare original/formatted preview outputs, exact undo/redo, idempotence, HTML quoted > and comment preservation, and invalid HTML source retention. Logs additionally show distinct JS computed colors and HTML token categories. The long-line implementation uses unwrapped overflowing editor rows and DOM text-range hit testing (src/style.css: custom-code-editor rules; custom-editor.js:524-552); the deep browser probe demonstrates a >500-character tail edit and changed Run output. (3) src/runtime.ts:312-362 prepares both JS and complete HTML and preserves source; 46-48,113-115,213-227 supply authored error locations. Preview frames are sandboxed without same-origin permission, CSP disallows preview network/dynamic evaluation, and real imports are rejected (7,50-52,222-225,374,385). Last-good DOM, form values and canvas pixels are captured/restored (8-30,159-202,365-401); loop guards, timer/callback tracking, watchdog and frame/token supersession support timeout/Stop/newer Run (33-75,139-142,228-279,371-401). The runtime matrix actually asserts interactive DOM/console, changed input and blue canvas recovery, timeout reason, later recovery, cancelled markers, each boundary draft and harmless quoted words. These are product probes, not complete proofs of every prescribed assertion. (4) server.js:65-118 implements server reads, transactional revision-checked saves, retained snapshots and idempotent restore operation IDs; DB_PATH and durable tables are at 8,142-168. src/app.tsx:59-89 keeps dirty fields on save/restore conflict; 142-145 inspects historical fields without opening a different draft. Persistence browser logs show clean-context readback, stale saves in both roles, restore/retry/stale-restore and readback after killed/replaced server process. (5) Real buttons/inputs plus :focus-visible and Escape-then-Tab support polish; src/app.tsx:66-69,87,135-145 and formatter messages communicate outcomes and unsaved state. The focus script checks reachable focused Run/Save/Format/Find/editor/New/history controls; its logs and the 1440x900 screenshot show readable aligned code, distinct panes, no important overlap and coherent repeated controls. Visual high-score plausibility was independently inspected, not inferred from an automated visual flag. All five indexed artifact hashes were recomputed and match (browser 922614fd..., persistence fb7e152f..., screenshot 44c044be..., build 328a373f..., probe f2be1927...). Running server, runtime, app and served JS/CSS match frozen hashes; the container's unused custom-editor source is stale only in Escape handling, while its served JS matches the frozen JS SHA256 7fa3bf61b9f2301d40ce368f513a05ae089a69d6e2555b9666588120a50b5b8c and contains 'Press Tab to leave the editor.' Thus the served-browser observations concern the frozen behavior. A fake editor with decorative multicarets or matches could look convincing but fails required real-key exact-source/copy readbacks; a conforming canvas editor with different labels/colors is permitted by the criteria and is not excluded by golden-specific selectors. No criterion was found that the golden plausibly cannot satisfy.
